name: Nishina Ayaka
source: Vice President of the Student Council. She originally agrees to the Lovely Smile activities, and even agrees to assist Zenichi with the differentiation between “pure” and “impure”. A typical upperclassman adored by many of the students including Zenichi himself. Ayaka is also detached from the rest of the members; many of the scenes only involve the four heroines mentioned previously.
